entities.summary: Khyri Jaquan Thomas is an American professional basketball player for Mitteldeutscher BC of the Basketball Bundesliga. He played college basketball for the Creighton Bluejays. He was drafted 38th overall by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 2018 NBA draft and then traded to the Detroit Pistons.
